text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Datadog ingestion delay detected for logs/traces in us-west-2 — spikes in queueing and >30s delivery delays. Auto-threshold breached at 16:12 UTC.

sara: seeing the same on console, traces are landing but logs are delayed/backfilled. UI shows 'Ingest backlog' for the last 14m.

allen: paging oncall-n1. tagging @sara for visibility.

oncall-n1: on it, joining. quick question — are any customer-facing monitors degraded or just internal dashboards?

sara: internal dashboards (cost/latency views) are missing recent samples. A few customer SLO alerts are firing (high latency) but those are from edge metrics (not Datadog).

kai: Datadog status page shows partial ingestion degradation for US regions. Might be a downstream pipeline blackout. https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingest-....

opsbot: Created ticket DD-8472 with Datadog support, severity raised to P1.

oncall-n1: thanks. immediate mitigation: can we flip to fallback telemetry path for critical SLOs (CloudWatch metrics + internal sampling)?

dana: we have forwarding for some metrics to CloudWatch but traces and logs are not. We can enable reduced sampling on edge to push essential metrics through logs->metrics transform. That should reduce volume.

sara: +1 to sampling. also turning on local buffering (persist to S3) will avoid data loss but increases recovery work.

allen: note for postmortem: correlate this with recent Datadog agent rollout in us-west-2 last night (agent 7.12.3).

oncall-n1: doing quick impact assessment — customers with heavy realtime dashboards will experience gaps. No active outage to API traffic APis yet.

kai: executing mitigation steps now: 1) lower log level to WARN on high-volume services 2) enable metrics-forwarding to CloudWatch for critical SLOs 3) reduce sampling rate for traces to 1%.

opsbot: Action log: lowered log volume on payment-service, checkout-service. CloudWatch forwarding enabled for route-latency and error-rate.

sara: Datadog support responded: they confirm ingestion pipeline congestion; team is rebalancing shards. ETA unknown.

oncall-n1: I'm going to open a public status banner. propose messaging: "We are experiencing delayed observability metrics and logs due to third-party ingestion delays. Application traffic unaffected, teams may see missing telemetry." Thoughts?

dana: fine. add "we're using fallbacks and will update when Datadog resolves" and link to Datadog ticket ID.

allen: start a #customer-impact thread for any customer tickets referencing missing metrics. prioritize enterprise accounts with SLA.

kai: temporary playbook note — for any alert that depends solely on Datadog logs/alerts, rely on internal healthchecks and CloudWatch fallbacks until ingestion normalizes.

incident-bot: HANDOFF to next oncall in 1h (oncall-n2). Please provide summary in handoff message.

oncall-n1: handoff summary: Datadog ingest backlog in us-west-2 causing delayed logs/traces; mitigations applied: reduced log volume, enabled CloudWatch forwarding, reduced trace sampling, Datadog ticket DD-8472 open, monitoring Datadog status + internal fallbacks. Customers: possible dashboard gaps only; no API downtime.

oncall-n1: leaving now to reduce noise. ping me if Datadog escalates to full outage.

oncall-n2: acknowledged, joining. will keep watch, will escalate to Eng-Infra if shard rebalances don't clear in 30m.

dana: putting a brief incident note in the incident tracker and assigning postmortem lead (sara).

sara: postmortem lead ack. will gather timelines: agent rollout, onset of backlog, mitigation actions, customer tickets.

allen: reminder: capture evidence of any missed alerts for SLA review.

kai: Datadog updated: ingestion backlog decreasing but still delayed ~8-12m. Monitoring recovery.

incident-bot: RESOLVE CONDITION: remaining backlog below threshold and delivery latency <30s for 10m.

oncall-n2: closing active paging loop. will keep this thread pinned until fully recovered.

sara: thanks everyone. postmortem draft will land tomorrow. :memo:
